title: Add a navigation menu
blurb: Put a menu at the top of your site so visitors can find every page.

steps.title: Edit your home page
steps.body: Pick the home page and click **Edit** to open the builder.
steps.tip: Put the menu in a header section, then save that section so every page can reuse it.

steps.title: Drop in the menu
steps.body: In the elements list on the left, find **Navigation Menu** and drag it into the top section of the page.

steps.title: Add menu items
steps.body: Select the menu. In the right panel, add a new menu item for each page, name it (like **Services**) and link it to that page.

steps.title: Add a dropdown (optional)
steps.body: Add a sub item under a parent, for example individual services under **Services**. One level of dropdown is supported.

steps.title: Check it on mobile
steps.body: Switch to mobile view. The menu folds into a tap-to-open icon. Make sure every link works, then click **Save**.
